# 2 Samuel Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 196v–197v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2SA_023_page_001.jpg, 2SA_023_page_002.jpg, 2SA_023_page_003.jpg

---

**23:1** And-these [are]-[the]-words of-David the-last:
"[The]-utterance [ne'um] of-David son of-Yishai,
and-[the]-utterance of-the-man raised-on-high [huqam 'al],
[the]-anointed [meshiach] of-[the]-God of-Ya'aqov,
and-the-pleasant-one of-[the]-songs [zemirot] of-Yisra'el:

**23:2** [The]-spirit [ruach] of-YHWH spoke in-me,
and-his-word [millato] [was]-upon my-tongue.

**23:3** Said the-God of-Yisra'el,
to-me spoke the-Rock [Tsur] of-Yisra'el:
'A-ruler [moshel] over-men, [a]-righteous-one [tsaddiq],
a-ruler in-[the]-fear of-God —

**23:4** and-like-[the]-light of-morning [boqer], [the]-sun rises [yizrach-shemesh],
a-morning without clouds;
from-brightness [minnoghah], from-rain [mimmatar],
grass [deshe'] from-[the]-earth.'

**23:5** For [is]-not so my-house with God?
For a-covenant [berit] of-eternity ['olam] he-set for-me,
arranged in-all and-guarded [shemurah].
For all my-salvation [yish'i] and-all desire [chefets] —
will-he-not cause-[it]-to-sprout [yatsmiyach]?

**23:6** And-[the]-worthless-ones [beliyya'al] — like-thorns [kotsim] thrust-away [munad], all of-them,
for not by-hand they-are-taken.

**23:7** And-[the]-man [who]-touches them
fills-himself [with]-iron and-[the]-shaft of-a-spear,
and-in-the-fire burning they-shall-be-burned [saref yissarefu] in-[the]-dwelling [ba-shavet]."

**23:8** These [are]-the-names of-the-mighty-ones [gibborim] who [were]-to-David: Yoshev-Basshevet [Josheb-basshebeth] a-Tachkemoni, chief [rosh] of-the-three [ha-shalishi]; he [was] Adino the-Etsnite ['Adino ha-'Etsni] — over eight-hundred slain at-one time.

**23:9** And-after-him Ele'azar son of-Dodo [son of]-the-Achoachi [ha-Achochi], among-the-three mighty-ones [gibborim] with David when-they-defied [becharpam] the-Pelishtim. [They]-gathered there for-battle, and-went-up [the]-men of-Yisra'el.

**23:10** He arose and-struck the-Pelishtim until [his]-hand was-weary [yag'ah], and-clung [tidbaq] his-hand to the-sword. And-made YHWH a-great salvation [teshu'ah] on-that day, and-the-people returned after-him only to-strip [the-slain].

**23:11** And-after-him Shammah son of-Age the-Harari. And-gathered the-Pelishtim to-a-troop [la-chayyah], and-there-was there a-plot [chelqat] of-the-field full of-lentils [adashim], and-the-people fled from-before [the]-Pelishtim.

**23:12** And-he-stationed-himself [vayyityatstsev] in-[the]-midst of-the-plot and-delivered-it [vayyatstsileha] and-struck the-Pelishtim. And-made YHWH a-great salvation.

**23:13** And-went-down three of-the-thirty chiefs [rosh] and-came at-harvest-time to David, to-[the]-cave of-Adullam. And-[the]-troop [chayyat] of-[the]-Pelishtim [was]-encamped in-[the]-valley of-Refa'im.

**23:14** And-David [was]-then in-the-stronghold [metsudah], and-[the]-garrison [matstsav] of-[the]-Pelishtim [was]-then in-Bet-Lechem.

**23:15** And-longed [vayit'avveh] David and-said, "Who will-give-me-to-drink [yashqeni] water from-[the]-cistern [bor] of-Bet-Lechem that [is]-by-the-gate?"

**23:16** And-broke-through [vayyivqe'u] the-three mighty-ones [gibborim] the-camp of-[the]-Pelishtim and-drew water from-[the]-cistern of-Bet-Lechem that [is]-by-the-gate. And-they-carried [it] and-brought [it] to David. And-he-was-not willing [lo-avah] to-drink-it, and-he-poured-it-out [vayyassekh] to-YHWH.

**23:17** And-he-said, "Far-be-it [chalilah] from-me, YHWH, to-do this! [Is it not]-the-blood of-the-men who-went at-[the-risk-of]-their-lives [nefesh]?" And-he-was-not willing to-drink-it. These [things] did the-three mighty-ones.

**23:18** And-Avishai [the]-brother of-Yo'av son of-Tseruyah — he [was]-chief of-the-three [ha-sheloshim, or ha-shalishi]. And-he wielded [orer] his-spear over three-hundred slain, and-[he had]-a-name among-the-three.

**23:19** From-the-three [was]-he-not most-honored [nikhbad]? And-he-was to-them a-captain [sar]. But-to the-[first]-three he-did-not attain.

**23:20** And-Benayahu son of-Yehoyada, son of-a-man-of-valor [ben-ish-chayil], great of-deeds [rav-pe'alim], from-Qavtse'el — he struck the-two [sons of]-Ari'el of-Moav. And-he went-down and-struck the-lion [ha-ari] in-[the]-midst of-the-pit [ha-bor] on-[the]-day of-the-snow [ha-shaleg].

**23:21** And-he struck an-Egyptian man, a-man of-appearance [mar'eh]. And-in-[the]-hand of-the-Egyptian [was]-a-spear, and-he-went-down to-him with-a-staff [shevet]. And-he-snatched [vayyigzol] the-spear from-[the]-hand of-the-Egyptian and-killed-him with-his-[own]-spear.

**23:22** These [things] did Benayahu son of-Yehoyada, and-[he had]-a-name among-the-three mighty-ones.

**23:23** From-the-thirty he-was-honored [nikhbad], but-to the-[first]-three he-did-not attain. And-set-him David over his-bodyguard [mishma'at].

**23:24** Asa'el [the]-brother of-Yo'av [was] among-the-thirty:
Elchanan son of-Dodo of-Bet-Lechem,

**23:25** Shammah the-Charodi,
Eliqah the-Charodi,

**23:26** Chelets the-Palti,
Ira son of-Iqqesh the-Teqo'i,

**23:27** Avi'ezer the-Antoti,
Mevunnai the-Chushati,

**23:28** Tsalmon the-Achoachi,
Maharai the-Netofahti,

**23:29** Chelev son of-Ba'anah the-Netofahti,
Ittai son of-Rivai from-Giv'ah of-[the]-sons of-Binyamin,

**23:30** Benayahu the-Pir'atoni,
Hiddai from-[the]-wadis of-Ga'ash,

**23:31** Avi-Alvon the-Arvati,
Azmavet the-Barchummi,

**23:32** Elyachba the-Sha'alvoni,
[the]-sons of-Yashen — Yehonatan,

**23:33** Shammah the-Harari,
Achiam son of-Sharar the-Harari,

**23:34** Elifelet son of-Achasbai son of-the-Ma'akhati,
Eli'am son of-Achitofel the-Giloni,

**23:35** Chetsro the-Karmeli,
Pa'arai the-Arbi,

**23:36** Yig'al son of-Natan from-Tsovah,
Bani the-Gadi,

**23:37** Tseleq the-Ammoni,
Nacharai the-Be'eroti, bearer of-[the]-weapons of-Yo'av son of-Tseruyah,

**23:38** Ira the-Yitri,
Garev the-Yitri,

**23:39** Uriyyah [Uriah] the-Chitti [the Hittite] — thirty-seven in-all.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — ne'um:** The word נְאֻם ("utterance/oracle") is the technical term for prophetic speech, typically used for divine oracles ("utterance of YHWH"). David applies it to himself, claiming the authority of a prophet.

**v.1 — ne'im zemirot:** "The pleasant one of the songs of Israel" — or possibly "the favorite of Israel's songs." The phrase is ambiguous: David is either the beloved singer or the subject of beloved songs.

**v.3-4 — the just ruler:** The syntax is difficult. I render it as a description of the ideal ruler: righteous, God-fearing, like the dawn sunlight that makes grass grow after rain. The imagery links just kingship to cosmic fertility.

**v.8 — Josheb-basshebeth / Adino the Eznite:** This verse is notoriously corrupt. The MT reads as a proper name ("Josheb-basshebeth a Tahchemonite") but the parallel in 1 Chr 11:11 reads "Jashobeam a Hachmonite." The phrase "Adino the Eznite" may be a corruption of "he wielded his spear" (*adino 'ets chanito*).

**v.13 — sheloshim rosh:** "Thirty chiefs" — the text says "three of the thirty chiefs," indicating an elite subgroup within the Thirty.

**v.17 — blood of the men:** David refuses to drink water obtained at the risk of men's lives (*nefesh*). He treats it as equivalent to their blood and pours it out as a libation to YHWH — an extraordinary act of reverence for both God and his warriors.

**v.34 — Eli'am son of Achitofel the Gilonite:** Eliam's father is Ahithophel, David's counselor who later betrayed him by supporting Absalom's revolt (2 Sam 15–17). If Eliam is the father of Bathsheba (cf. 2 Sam 11:3), then Ahithophel was Bathsheba's grandfather — which may explain his motivation for betraying David.

**v.39 — Uriyyah the Chitti:** The final name in the list is devastating in context. Uriah the Hittite — David's loyal warrior whom David had killed to cover his adultery with Bathsheba (2 Sam 11). The narrator places this name last, ensuring the reader cannot finish the catalog of David's heroes without remembering David's greatest sin.

*— EMET*
